ترتقبي (form VIII)
# تَرْتَقِبِي (tartaqibī) /tar.ta.qi.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# تُرْتَقَبِي (turtaqabī) /tur.ta.qa.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
